name: trips
label: Trips
definition: Completed trips. Includes trips flagged by data-quality rules, so totals match TLC's published counts.

name: gross_bookings
label: Gross Bookings
definition: Everything riders paid except tips (fare, tolls, taxes, surcharges, airport and congestion fees).

name: platform_margin
label: Platform Margin (fare - driver pay)
definition: Base fare minus driver pay. Tolls, taxes and fees are pass-through and excluded. A proxy for platform revenue.

name: market_share
label: Market Share (trips)
definition: The company's share of all Uber + Lyft trips in the same slice (period, zone).

name: fare_per_mile
label: Fare per Mile
definition: Base fare divided by trip miles.

name: take_rate
label: Take Rate
definition: Share of the base fare the platform keeps after driver pay. Can be negative where incentives push driver pay above fare (DQ-05).

name: avg_wait_min
label: Average Wait (min)
definition: Minutes from ride request to pickup. Excludes impossible or extreme waits (DQ-02).

name: pickup_within_5min_rate
label: Picked Up Within 5 Min
definition: Share of riders picked up within 5 minutes of requesting. Chosen over median wait because it is additive and so stays correct at any grain, in every tool.

name: shared_match_rate
label: Shared Ride Match Rate
definition: Share of shared-ride requests matched with another rider.

name: wav_fulfillment_rate
label: WAV Fulfillment Rate
definition: Share of wheelchair-accessible vehicle requests served by a WAV.

name: driver_earnings_per_engaged_hour
label: Driver Earnings per Engaged Hour
definition: Driver pay plus tips per hour on trip. Engaged time only, because the data has no idle or en-route time.

name: tip_rate
label: Tip Rate
definition: Tips as a share of base fare.

name: crz_trip_share
label: Congestion-Zone Trip Share
definition: Share of trips starting or ending in the Manhattan congestion relief zone (south of 60th St).

name: airport_trip_share
label: Airport Trip Share
definition: Share of trips starting or ending at JFK, LaGuardia or Newark.

name: cbd_fee_revenue
label: Congestion Fee Collected
definition: Congestion relief zone fees collected from riders and passed to the MTA (from 5 Jan 2025).
